sections.title: Investment Recommendation
sections.text: Visa’s business durability is supported by a high operating margin [[V.ratio.operating_margin]], strong free cash flow [[V.ratio.free_cash_flow]], and moderate leverage [[V.ratio.debt_to_equity]]. The firm faces risk from rising client incentives [source:K:L839][source:E:L44] and ongoing regulatory scrutiny such as the UK interchange litigation [source:Q:L1180]. If operating margin were to decline materially or regulatory outcomes were to tighten pricing, the recommendation would be revised downward.

insight.text: Visa delivers an exceptionally high return on equity
